gen-gf-gabarito-gf-ibm-plex-sans-jp: Expressive and a little cheeky, Gabarito draws every stroke like one marker line, with open endings. IBM Plex Sans JP follows with a friendlier, steadier hand that keeps the page easy to move through.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-ibm-plex-sans-kr: Gabarito's bowls never swell, just a single marker-like line curling open at its ends. And IBM Plex Sans KR takes over below with a modern, open-ended build that quietly carries the text.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai: Loose, marker-drawn display letters up top, then a tidy sans-serif underneath. Gabarito has the swagger, while IBM Plex Sans Thai keeps its open curves easy to follow line after line.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai-lo: IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped reads clean and unfussy, its curves refusing to close. Gabarito's one-nib heading brings the personality, so enlarge the body a touch if you want those open shapes to breathe.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-imprima: Imprima brings a smooth, tube-like line with flared endings, sitting under Gabarito's expressive, one-nib heading letters. Paragraphs of it would feel soft and approachable.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-inclusive-sans: Inclusive Sans reads professional and contemporary, with round letters whose rims match their stems and open ends on every curve. Next to Gabarito's expressive heading, its best quality is how smoothly the two sit together.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-istok-web: Gabarito keeps its stroke widths constant from stem to curve, giving headings a drawn, distinctive character. Istok Web, a modern plain sans, handles the friendly everyday reading.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-jost: Open, marker-like, and distinctive up top. Gabarito leads with those cut-open terminals, while Jost follows in a clean, professional line with broad gaps, and you can nudge its size up for comfort.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-jura: Jura reads neutral and clean, its strokes as constant as bent wire and its s curves open wide. Gabarito sits above with a more expressive, one-nib hand, so the two feel related yet clearly different.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-k2d: Marker-bold and open-ended, Gabarito makes a distinctive heading with its cut-open terminals. And K2D, a sans-serif with a tube-like thickness through every bend, keeps long reading feeling clean and neutral.
